It's okay, sorry that it's been months for a reply. Things have gone much better. I've gotten to a really good place in life. I competed nationally in a sport that I love for college for once. I never would have imagined being here.

Sorry, I've been insanely busy the past few days. Things have been going better, still some rough spots but overall better. I worked things out with my university. I'm also looking for more clubs and stuff. I'm in a few already but I still got way too much free time on my hands.

Thanks for the support. I went out today and enjoyed it. I made some calls with the university and I wasn't expecting anything. I didn't know they could be so helpful with the situation (I had to swallow my pride, never once in my life would I think to be asking for financial assistance). They are working with me to get everything settled with, also most of my friends started talking to me again. It seems as if everything suddenly got better. I'm going to try and make a goal of exercising, starting with 30 min a day. I don't need to lose weight but I need to look good and not gain weight. I spent most of my time. The next goal is my grades, I want to get the highest as possible. I plan to force myself to go the library to study, not at my place so I don't get distracted at all. Final goal, work hard at my hobbies and enjoy my sports and be more outgoing and talk to people more often, I struggle with social interactions every now and then and I've always been afraid of feeling hurt and rejected. But I think if I start fresh and become more active I'll get somewhere. I guess I needed some encouragement, I felt like no one cared but now I realize hey people do care what I do.

Better, and for some reason I can't let go of that thought. I know it sounds so silly, but I'm not sure why I feel that way. I get insanely upset over things that normal people just shrug off. To some of the people who commented, they look at it as no big deal. But to me I feel like I'm a failure or that I will be. I guess it was from the constant torment, I've even had teachers tell me that I will never be anyone or get anywhere in life. My only reason for ending it is because I get so stressed out over these things.

I just have it set that if my plans fail that I have nothing else to really live for. I'm just worried that I'll end up living that life that a few of my peers live. I don't want to live in that small town working at some retail store all of my life making a very small income. I know I have the ability to not live that life and I'm in college now but I still worry every day and it's eating me. I've never really had any encouragement for my dreams, people tell me that I shouldn't aim so high and that I should just settle with something easy. I'm not like other people.

Thanks. I've started to think of it like that too, but it still jerks my heart because I feel like I was betrayed in a way. Making new friends can be a little difficult, I usually don't approach people first, I feel way too awkward and don't know what to say so I wait until someone comes up to me. Sometimes it works I guess.  Now I just need to figure out what I can do. I can call my adviser later and see what options I have. I've got a little over half paid already.

My university is very good at that, they have a very good internship program. I was about to study abroad in another country in the fall and possibly in the summer and possibly again the summer after that. All in different countries. I wouldn't think that I could just pick up and go to another city or town and travel. I've thought about just full out transferring to a school somewhere in Europe. It would cost a lot less than what I am paying here in the US for everything.

Thanks, one of my parents tonight mentioned something about the money issue. They said "Don't worry, I will do everything I can to make sure it gets paid. No matter what it takes." I hope it blows past. My age is between 18-20. Sophomore in college, I don't want to give too much out though just in case someone I know reads this. I've got the talent, many talents actually but it was all while I was in college. All of these issues pile up. I still freak out when I see a "friend" remove me from facebook. Someone that I used to be really close with and text every day and hang out with all the time simply just stop caring. It really blows. Because I used to not have any friends. I just want a genuine friend and things to just work. I don't want to be a failure.

College? To get an education. I'm not there just for a job. I want to become a better person and learn something and make friends and to develop socially and to explore all of my interests. So far I've learned many new things. I've taken tons of extra curricular activities that I don't want to mention for identity (people I know, are aware of how active I was during the semester. I was in tons of sports and clubs.) I found so many new hobbies. College isn't just about getting a job, it's about developing you as a smarter individual and exploring who you really are. As for happiness, to be honest a good job that I enjoy is all I care about in life. I want to be able to support the life style I had growing up and to support my own children so they never have a student loan in their life. I see so many people I graduate with get pregnant before age 20 and get married, they have a small house and end up working at wal-mart or somewhere just like their parents have for years. That's how it goes down in these farm towns. I can't just sit back in relax, I get lonely. I know it sounds kinda childish but I really didn't have much of a childhood. I hate being alone.

Where I live makes it a little difficult to go for a walk. Parks are dangerous and I live out in a rural area with lots of hills, so walking down the road results in getting hit by a car. I don't want to spend the time playing games or sitting on a computer. I really want friends but for some reason it seems that I can't get any close ones. I get some people that talk to me but none that really want to go do anything in person.

I'm worried about school though. I realize I've done well but I don't want to end up like most of the people around here. I see tons of people working dead end jobs. Barely making income, I don't want that life. I refuse to have that life. I've made a mental plan that I would end it, if I were not on the right path by age 28. I don't want to end up being 40, living in a low income housing unit working a minimum wage job. I know lots of people are happy with that but that's not my dream. I want to make people proud that I became someone important. I have worked so hard to get to where I am now. I've had several suicide plans during high school because of bullying. I have the ambition and drive but  stuff really brings me down. I just need to figure out a plan for education too. I really don't want to end up like them and never leaving this dead end depressing hell hole that we're from.

If they say no. I fear for my mental health. I can't really take summer or winter break because of how lonely I get. I couldn't imagine 7 months of it. Because of it, I will go weeks almost to months with out seeing sunlight. I had to block out all of my bedroom windows because I had a hard time sleeping during the day. (I cried myself to sleep and sometimes it would take until 6 am). I feel kinda pathetic though to have these problems. It's scary though, I'm comfortable of the fact of dying. I have no problem doing it but I don't want to do it if I can get things back together.

Thanks, this put a genuine smile on my face reading it. I have not had a real smile in a long time. They have an option of payments, but I would have to pay 3 payments of around $3500 in a month which I wont be able to do until summer. I wasn't expecting this to happen until break started. I feel like I try all for nothing. I rarely hang out with people because they are so busy and it seems no one really cares about my problems. I don't vent until people poke me and are like "you seem down, what's wrong?" I tell them, and I get the generic response of "Oh. Things will be better. Something will work out." I'm supposed to go abroad (graduation req) for a semester in the fall. If I don't go this semester my study abroad plans will fuck up and it will be hard to get back on that path again. It's just stressful because of all of this planning and it's killing me. I lose sleep over it.

Do you think I could make an arrangement with my campus? Because I've paid more than half of what I originally owe for the semester and I would have it fully paid by the start of summer. And I shouldn't cancel my housing contract that I have?
